about_the_game:
Battleline - The Range Demo 

  • The release of the free demo serves as both a training ground for players and a testing ground for future features, allowing the community to shape the evolution of the game. Explore the interactive training range and dynamic killhouse, where you can master weapons meticulously recreated from iconic eras and conflicts.

  • As a labor of passion, Battleline strives to push the boundaries of VR realism and storytelling, providing players with a glimpse of the full game’s potential. Your feedback will help refine and expand this ambitious project into a fully-fledged historical VR experience.

Game Features

Immersive & Realistic Environment

Interactive VR Gameplay

Expanding Weapons & Gear

Jump in, lock and load, and join the journey as we build Battleline together.

Join Us on Discord
"Link is attached to the side panel"

content_descriptors.notes: Battleline Demo features the use of realistic weapons and shooting mechanics, including firing at targets in a training range and killhouse environment. it involves combat-related themes that may not be suitable for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 Ghz CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, HTC Vive, Windows Mixed Reality, Pico, and Valve Index
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Battleline is an indie VR shooter created by a solo developer, offering a free and immersive first look at the groundbreaking weapon systems and mechanics at the heart of the Battleline experience.
